# GAAS R&D Library

> Research & Development knowledge library structured as an incompressible multidimensional complex system.

Site: https://library.tanaakk.com

## Important
- Prefer these plain-text indexes and sitemap.xml for discovery.
- Human UI is a SPA; crawlable HTML snapshots are also generated per URL at build time.

## Entry points
- https://library.tanaakk.com/en/dashboard
- https://library.tanaakk.com/ja/dashboard
- https://library.tanaakk.com/vi/dashboard
- https://library.tanaakk.com/en/nobel/physics
- https://library.tanaakk.com/en/tier1-awards/fields
- https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics
- https://library.tanaakk.com/en/institutions
- https://library.tanaakk.com/en/schema

## Design principles
- Incompressibility Principle — cannot be compressed into a single hierarchy
- Multidimensional structure — expressed across multiple judgment axes
- Bidirectional co-creation — mutual influence between mathematics ↔ R&D

## Coverage
- Nobel Prize categories: physics, chemistry, physiology_or_medicine, literature, peace, economic_sciences
- Tier 1 awards: breakthrough, abel, fields, turing, lasker, copley, hermann_weyl
- Frontier topics: 20
